project: The First Perception - Living World RPG Engine
version_notes: v0.8 schema pack — Sec L bundle promotion (~46 anchors across Bundles A-H) + 8 cluster anchors (Cluster B BES/FS + Cluster C CMB) + 14 foundation $defs surfaced by Phase 24a (weather_pattern, exit_block, poi_block, lock_requirement_block, skill_check_block, secret_block, dialogue_state_block, goal_block, action_economy_block, trigger_block, effect_block, faction_plan_block, focus_block, npc_closing_condition_entry). Phase 24a Player-runtime additions documented as REQUIRED. Engine-types.ts duplicate-shape absorption per Option A (Session 5 cutover). Stats dual-block storage per Khoja Option C (custom_stats_block + derived_stats_block both REQUIRED on PlayerSchema). Focus per Khoja Option B (focus_block new $def). Sources: V08_PROMOTION_SCOPE.md (Session 3.5 locked output), repo_mirror/phase_24a/*, bundle_specs/*.md.
manifesto_guardrails: Greywake is the seed, not the soil
Authority has a price (universal canon-cost layer on leveled spellcasting)

0.8.0.engine_types_absorption_strategy: Option A (Session 5 cutover) — engine-types.ts duplicates absorbed into schema entities

0.8.0.focus_block: Option B (focus_block new $def, mirrors HpBlock pattern)

changelog.0.4: 25 additives across Bundle A + Bundle C; 5 new top-level schemas. Closes v0.4 R-60 redux. Manifesto regression check clean.
changelog.0.3: Initial formalization of v0.2 + v0.3 additive fields. Closed R-60.
changelog.0.2: (unreleased) workflow atlas + ERD + contradiction ledger entry shapes
changelog.0.1: Initial schema pack: campaign, player, event, faction, npc, rumor, belief, consequence, state_diff

0.5.0.summary: Full-sweep v0.5 additive: 80 candidates applied (19 SC/R-73, 44 FDR, 17 P).
0.5.0.regression_check: v0.4.1 records remain valid — all additions are optional fields or new schemas.

0.6.0.summary: Catalog port: discriminator-typed item subtypes, v2-canonical recipe shape, new litany/marginalia/imposed_spell schemas, field gap closures.
breaking_changes: recipe.ingredients -> materials; output_item_id -> produces_item_id; station_required -> primary_station_id. v1 normalized at port.

0.7.0.summary: Opex throttle layer: +3 schemas (opex_state, opex_event, model_tier_policy) for daily-cap counter, per-call ledger, and tiered-fallback routing policy.

weather_pattern.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Region weather variability source-of-truth. No v0.7 equivalent; runtime Region.weatherPatterns had no schema home.

type.description: Weather kind: sun, fog, storm, salt-rain, low-tide, high-tide, etc.

skill_check_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Generic skill check shape. Uses CoreStat per Khoja Option C dual-stats decision (engine narrative system reads custom_stats; SRD layers read derived_stats via translation rule).

stat.description: 9-CoreStat Tide-Stained system. v0.8 stat system per Khoja Option C.

dc.description: Difficulty class threshold the d20 roll + stat modifier must meet or exceed.

lock_requirement_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Exit.locked structured shape. Either a key-item, a skill check, or both gate the exit.

key_item_id.description: FK → item.item_id; null if no key required.

exit_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — LocationNode.exits structured shape. Reconciles with v0.7 travel_route $def (inverse direction); v0.8 keeps both; engine adapter translates at scene-load boundary.

poi_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — LocationNode.pointsOfInterest structured shape. Sub-location investigation surface.

secret_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — NPC.secrets[] structured shape. Per-secret reveal mechanics. v0.8 promotes from runtime Secret type.

topic_id.description: Topic category — used by dialogue_state_block + Bundle G information shaping_operator.

difficulty.description: DC required to extract the secret. Paired with skill_check_block when an explicit check is performed.

dialogue_state_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — NPC.dialogueState structured replacement for opaque Record<string, unknown>. Pairs with Bundle F prompt_skeleton + Bundle G knowledge_tri_layer.says policy.

active_topic_id.description: Currently-open dialogue topic; null if NPC is idle.

exhausted.description: Topic has been fully explored; no further dialogue available.

stance_drift.description: Cumulative dialogue-driven stance shift; engine uses to adjust faction trust.

transient_flags.description: Per-turn dialogue flags (e.g. {threatened: true, charmed: false}). Cleared on dialogue exit.

goal_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Structured goal shape replacing NPC.wants string + Faction.goals opaque arrays. Pairs with Bundle A want_model (NPC scale) + Bundle C faction_ledger (faction scale).

target_id.description: Optional FK to the target entity (npc_id / faction_id / item_id / location_id / belief_id).

abandoned_reason.description: Populated when goal is dropped without being achieved.

action_economy_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Per-turn action budget. Promoted from runtime ActionEconomy (Phase 24a Player.actionEconomy).

reaction.description: Reaction available until next turn start.

trigger_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Structured predicate replacing runtime Consequence.trigger. Pairs with schema's existing consequence.trigger_type + trigger_value.

kind.description: Trigger taxonomy. Matches v0.7 consequence.trigger_type enum + adds narrative_event.

value.description: Trigger-specific value (e.g. day number for time, condition_id for condition, threshold spec for threshold).

predicate.description: Optional engine-evaluated predicate for complex triggers.

armed_at.description: Timestamp / world_time when the trigger became active.

effect_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Structured effect shape for what happens when a consequence/condition fires. Replaces runtime ConditionEffect + Effect.

kind.description: Effect taxonomy. Matches the visible categories the runtime emits.

target.description: FK to the entity affected (player / npc_id / faction_id / region_id / item_id).

magnitude.description: Signed magnitude where applicable (e.g. stat_modifier=+2; hp_delta=-3).

duration_turns.description: How long the effect lasts. null = permanent until removed; 0 = instantaneous.

narrative_phrase.description: Optional engine-narration phrase for tale entries.

faction_plan_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Structured faction plan replacing opaque envelope. Pairs with Bundle C faction_tick_resolution.

current_step.description: Index into plan_steps[] of the step the faction is currently executing.

cadence.description: Tick cadence (same enum as ambition_tick.cadence per Bundle A).

target_entity_id.description: Optional FK to the entity this step acts on.

result_band.description: Outcome band; null until step resolves.

last_tick_at.description: Timestamp / world_time of last cadence tick.

session_state_block.description: Phase 4a.5 — Session-state per Bundle H Hardening. Carries Phase 23b ending-detection flags + Phase 22.6 ticker queue + transient per-session state. Lives on Player as session_state field. Bundle H L.VIII-SC-01..04 may extend.

current_session_id.description: FK to session entity (when Bundle H session schema lands).

ending_committed.description: Phase 23b PROD-601 guard — endingDetector setting this prevents re-fire.

notice_thresholds_fired.description: Phase 23b PROD-602 — notice ladder transitions already fired this session.

ticker_queue.description: Phase 23b PROD-603 — WorldPulse ticker items pending surface. Item shape: world_pulse_ticker_item $def.

apotheosis_accepted_this_turn.description: Phase 23b SEM-604 — set by apotheosis command parser; consumed by endingDetector.

transient_flags.description: Free-form per-turn flags cleared on session boundary.

last_main_scene_focus_at.description: R-119-E per Glance Bar mechanism (FDR Part 2.3).

focus_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 — NEW $def per Khoja Option B ratification (OPEN_QUESTIONS.md). Mirrors HpBlock structure. Required on PlayerSchema in v0.8. Focus is mechanically distinct from meters (meters = world-state perceptions; focus = character resource pool).

recovery_rate.description: Per-rest recovery; null = none. Engine reads at long-rest.

source_kind.description: Narrative context for the focus source.

npc_closing_condition_entry.description: Phase 24b §4.1 — Sub-$def used by Bundle A L.I-SC-03 closing_conditions field. Each NPC carries an array of ≥2 entries; ≥1 must be player_reachable=true (Death's binding rule).

kind.description: Closing-state taxonomy. Native Postgres ENUM at DDL emission time.

consequence_summary.description: Engine annotation for what the world looks like after this closure fires.

residue_drive.description: Populated on passover_state only — becomes new active drive after passover fires.

transfer_target_npc_id.description: Populated on transfer_state only — FK to receiving NPC.

want_model.description: Phase 24b §4.2 / Bundle A / L.I-SC-01 — NPC drive/barter/kill_for/fear_loss model. Lands on NpcSchema as REQUIRED. Aggregated up to FactionSchema in Bundle C. Source: Sec L.I Layer 1 (codex lines 8683-8691).

description.description: What the NPC wants. E.g. 'be named by The Unnamed before any rival'.

freshness_decay.description: Drive intensity decays over this many in-world days unless reinforced.

items.description: npc_id refs that, if present in audience, cause NPC to refuse this trade.

last_evaluated.description: Timestamp / world_time of last threshold check.

what.description: What the NPC dreads losing. E.g. 'her sister's parish standing'.

abandons_drive_if_imminent.description: If true, NPC drops their drive when fear_loss becomes imminent.

knowledge_tri_layer.description: Phase 24b §4.2 / Bundle A / L.I-SC-02 — knows/says/believes triangle (Garak's flag). Foundation for Bundle G Information Economy. Source: Sec L.I Layer 3 (codex lines 8718-8724).

knows.description: Facts the NPC has direct evidence of. May be empty for stub NPCs.

fact_id.description: Ref to event/belief/document the NPC knows.

per_audience_overrides.description: Per-audience-class policy overrides (regional packs add audience classes).

believes.description: Convictions distinct from knows. May be empty.

evidence_resistance.description: How resistant to contradicting evidence (1=easily swayed, 5=immovable).

ambition_tick.description: Phase 24b §4.2 / Bundle A / L.I-SC-05 — NPC's cadence for attempts at their drive. Feeds Bundle C faction_tick_resolution at faction scale. Source: Sec L.I Layer 5 (codex lines 8742-8758).

cadence.description: Tick cadence. 'special' is contradiction-bearing; engine handles per-case.

last_attempt.description: Timestamp / world_time of last attempt. Null = never.

success_streak.description: Signed integer. Positive = recent successes; negative = setback streak (House setback-bias governor reads this).

next_scheduled_attempt.description: Engine-computed from last_attempt + cadence. Null for 'special' cadence.

institution_cadence.description: Phase 24b §4.3 / Bundle B / L.II-SC-01 — Institutional decision rhythm. Nests above NpcSchema.schedule_nesting (L.I-SC-06).

internal_faction_entry.description: Phase 24b §4.3 / Bundle B / L.II-SC-04 — Sub-faction within an institution. Allows visible internal coalitions (e.g. Drowned Church reformists vs traditionalists).

faction_reach.description: Phase 24b §4.4 / Bundle C / L.III-SC-01 — Three-pronged faction reach per RT-21. Distinct public_reach (visible to player) and actual_reach (hidden); may intentionally diverge.

domain.description: e.g. doctrinal, civic, mercantile. Free-string; regional packs define values; lookup table at DDL time.

visible_to_player.description: Always false — actual_reach is the hidden ground truth.

faction_ledger.description: Phase 24b §4.4 / Bundle C / L.III-SC-02 — Faction financial state. Mutable runtime; lives in state.* schema.

kind.description: Transaction kind label (trade, tithe, fee, fine, etc.).

faction_tick_resolution.description: Phase 24b §4.4 / Bundle C / L.III-SC-03 — Per-tick engine output for a faction's attempt. House setback-bias governor records its application per tick.

setback_bias_applied.description: House governor: winning factions get +30% setback weight; this flag records whether the bias was applied.

delta_reach.description: Change to faction_reach intensity. Null = no reach delta this tick.

commodity_catalog_entry.description: Phase 24b §4.4 / Bundle C / L.III-SC-04 — Catalog entry for a tradable commodity. Engine commodity registry.

discovery_channel.description: Phase 24b §4.5 / Bundle D / L.IV-SC-02 — How a thread surfaces to the player. Six channels per L.IV (pull-not-push per House L.I governor).

surface_via_npc_id.description: FK to npc.npc_id when channel involves an NPC source.

surface_at_location_id.description: FK to location.location_id where the thread surfaced.

required_player_skill.description: Optional gating check for the channel (e.g. stumbled needs perception).

collision_pressure.description: Phase 24b §4.5 / Bundle D / L.IV-SC-03 — Cross-NPC tension that may emerge as a quest when it crosses surfacing_threshold.pressure_threshold.

subplot_admission_policy.description: Phase 24b §4.6 / Bundle E / L.V-SC-02 — Per-plot admission policy for candidate quests. Per L.VIII RT-32 (orthogonalized_subplot_admission patch), rejects cross-plot bleed unless cross_plot_resonance_allowed.

cross_plot_resonance.description: Phase 24b §4.6 / Bundle E / L.V-SC-04 — Inter-plot resonance primitive. Per L.VIII RT-31, smoothing_applied flag set by high_engagement_smoothing governor.

smoothing_applied.description: Set by L.VIII-SC-01 high_engagement_smoothing when player engagement crosses threshold.

pan_world_plot.description: Phase 24b §4.6 / Bundle E / L.V-SC-05 — Cross-regional plot anchor. Per RT-26: HC regions stay content-static; pan_world_plot touches them through ONE mechanism only (single_mechanic_hook).

plot_id.description: FK to a regional plot instance.

kind.description: Per RT-26: ONLY ONE kind per pan_world_plot.

high_engagement_smoothing.description: Phase 24b §4.6 / Bundle H / L.VIII-SC-01 — Engine governor patching cross_plot_resonance. Smooths when player is highly engaged (many active threads).

point_of_no_return_marker.description: Phase 24b §4.7 / FS-SC-02 — Per FS-RULE-2: every failure_state_branch must emit a readable signal within 1 in-world day of the point-of-no-return marker (CHECK constraint).

outcome_uncertainty_resolver.description: Phase 24b §4.7 / BES-SC-02 — Unnamed-Touched Echo mechanic. When triggered, certain engine rolls become indeterminate-until-resolved.

cross_regional_presence.description: Phase 24b §4.7 / BES-SC-03 — Pan-world creature presence. Per RT-26 (HC regions stay content-static): single_mechanic_touch.

social_attack.description: Phase 24b §4.7 / CMB-SC-02 — Combatant social-attack sub-type. Used by Aesthete-Magistrate, Sergeant of Sanctions, Closed-Books Servitor Operator (CMB.II.IV inventory).

stat.description: Per Option C dual-stats; CoreStat side.

cosmological_redirection.description: Phase 24b §4.7 / CMB-SC-03 — Sum-Wraith Whisperer signature negotiation mechanic. Combatant renegotiates wraith's target rather than fighting it.

orthogonalized_subplot_admission.description: Phase 24b §4.6 / Bundle H / L.VIII-SC-02 — Engine governor patching subplot_admission_policy. Prevents subplots that are just echoes of the parent plot.

personality_fingerprint.description: Phase 24b §4.8 / Bundle F / L.VI-SC-01 — Per-NPC voice fingerprint binding archetype + tonal constraints + drift tolerance. Pairs with prompt_skeleton (L.VI-SC-04) at generation time. NPCs with constraint-dominant voices (Listening Child, Butcher) use fingerprint_waiver override (L.VI-SC-05) rather than this fingerprint.

archetype_id.description: L.VI-SC-02 archetype_enum. 8 base + 4 extension archetypes (per L.VI memory 8+4 frozen set). Combatant.voice_archetype harmonizes against this enum (Phase 4.7 inline enum is superseded in 4.8).

required_lexical_anchors.description: Phrases/words the voice must surface periodically (e.g. 'Numerand' for Aesthete-Magistrate).

drift_tolerance.description: Higher = more permissive voice variation between turns. 0 = strict invariant; 10 = free drift.

slide_trigger.description: Phase 24b §4.8 / Bundle F / L.VI-SC-03 — Per-NPC fingerprint slide trigger. When conditions fire, slides voice from from_archetype → to_archetype. Pairs with personality_fingerprint.active_slide_trigger_ids.

reversible.description: True = slide reverts on opposing trigger. False = permanent shift.

fingerprint_waiver.description: Phase 24b §4.8 / Bundle F / L.VI-SC-05 — Cluster A constraint-dominant override (Listening Child + Butcher). NPCs with this waiver bypass personality_fingerprint generation and route to fixed prompt_skeleton.cluster_a_override path.

override_skeleton_id.description: FK to prompt_skeleton.skeleton_id with cluster_a_override = true.

skeleton_cache.description: Phase 24b §4.8 / Bundle H / L.VIII-SC-03 — Engine-level cache for prompt_skeleton renders. Avoids re-rendering identical fingerprint+context combinations. Lives in engine.* schema (per ARD-010 §3 engine internals).

fingerprint_hash.description: Stable hash of fingerprint + context inputs.

subplot_graph_relation.description: Phase 24b §4.5 / Bundle D / L.IV-SC-05 — Quest-to-quest relational primitive. Bundle E clusters via parent_plot_id; related_quest_ids tracks the subplot graph.

parent_plot_id.description: FK to Bundle E plot.plot_id once Bundle E lands.

emergence_path.description: Ordered list of trigger event_ids that produced this quest.

concealment_policy.description: Phase 24b §4.9 / Bundle G / L.VII-SC-02 — Per-information concealment rule. Defines which archetypes the info is hidden from + reveal mechanics + premature-reveal penalties.

conceal_from_archetypes.description: Personality archetypes that cannot witness this information without trigger.

reveal_dc.description: Optional skill-check DC when reveal_on_trigger_kind = skill_check.

shaping_operator.description: Phase 24b §4.9 / Bundle G / L.VII-SC-03 — Per-archetype information distortion operator. Applied when info traverses an intermediary NPC: amplify/attenuate/invert/fragment/euphemize/literalize per archetype voice.

third_party_document.description: Phase 24b §4.9 / Bundle G / L.VII-SC-04 — Document witness embedding information. Letters, ledgers, broadsheets, inscriptions. Decays over time (illegibility/loss).

decay_rate.description: 0 = imperishable (inscriptions); 10 = ephemeral (chalked broadsheet rinsed by tide).

archetype_lock.description: Phase 24b §4.9 / Bundle G / L.VII-SC-05 — Archetype-keyed lock on which voices may carry information. Bundle F+G interlock — gates info transmission by personality_archetype.

unlock_condition.description: Engine-evaluable predicate that lifts the lock.

daily_news_3tier.description: Phase 24b §4.9 / Bundle G / L.VII-SC-07 — Daily news layer: tier-1 local, tier-2 regional, tier-3 pan-world. Pairs with Bundle B institutional_response_queue (each tier may trigger queue entries).

scrip_stability_model.description: Phase 24b §4.4 / Bundle C / L.III-SC-07 — Scrip stability engine state. Feeds Bundle E pan_world_plot P-02 (The Scrip Run).

recent_shocks.description: Order-preserving log of recent shocks. Engine tail-trims to N most-recent.

schedule_nesting.description: Phase 24b §4.2 / Bundle A / L.I-SC-06 — Per-NPC schedule nested under an institution. Bridge to Bundle B (institutional schedules) + Bundle C (faction-scale scheduling). Source: Sec L.I (codex lines 8759-8771).

summary.description: Free-form per-game-hour pattern; engine renders as ink scheduling or per-scene routing.

nested_under_institution_id.description: FK to faction (or new Bundle B institution entity). Null = unaffiliated.

variance_seed.description: Per-playthrough perturbation seed (House governor: variance bands on stack initialization).

spell_cost_layer.description: R-51 universal canon-cost on leveled spellcasting. Cantrips remain free.

scarred_until_day.description: v0.4 Bundle A: when sworn slot is broken or fulfilled, may scar; cannot accept new attunement until this in-world day.

threshold_spent_until_day.description: v0.4.1 (R-86): in-world day until which a spent end-condition threshold cannot retrigger. Set when player refuses apotheosis (X.12), self-unmaking (X.13), or withdrawal (X.14). null means threshold is not in spent state. State Manager owns set; clears automatically when current_time.day exceeds this value.

kind.description: R-99-C: constrained vocabulary; Greywake-native frame locked

reversibility_event_id.description: R-101-C: canon-event that could reverse, if reversible

adaptagen_active.description: R-102-C: bottled mutagenic relics currently active

world_pulse_ticker_item.x_description: R-113-D: derived from events; transient session state for the Live Ticker UI.

party_state.description: R-132-P: top-level party tracking. 4-max party (1 player + up to 3 companions).

former_party_members.description: R-148-P: persistent post-departure state for companions who left the party.

session_log.description: R-97-B: ordered session_ids that have committed against this campaign. Multi-session replay support.

tab_grouping_1366.description: R-62 closure: per-tab collapse preferences at 1366×768

ui_preference_state.description: R-117-D: persistent UI prefs. Closes R-62.

world_pulse_recurring_events.description: R-127-F (speculative): scheduled events that fire on a cadence (e.g., weekly salt vigil) outside the agent loop.

form_of_ending_narration.description: R-88-A: Narrator-generated terminal text (postcard-shaped). Per Narrator Form-of-Ending prompt. Persisted for Death/Legacy screen rendering.

body_modifications_block.description: Deferred bundle (mad-sci track). Schema slot pre-wired per v0.4 Bundle A; awaiting design pass.

locations_known.description: R-107-C: per-location knowledge map (deferred bundle: exploration_system)

ai_cosmetic_slot.description: AI-generated cosmetic image path (set at character creation)

portrait_state.description: R-111-D: Portrait System state per FDR Part 1.5 spec.

knowledge_posture_history.description: R-115-D: posture switches over time; affects achievement eligibility per v0.1 Ch V.

session_state.description: Phase 4a.5 — Replaced inline shape with $ref to session_state_block (carries Phase 22.6/23b runtime flags + Bundle H session fields).

focus.description: Phase 4a.5 — REQUIRED per Khoja Option B (focus_block as symmetric HpBlock-pair resource pool).

action_economy.description: Phase 4a.5 — Optional per-turn action budget. Non-combatant scenes don't populate.

scrip_speculation_history.description: R-124-E: speculative-profit tracking for R-65 (scrip speculation cap at 25% gain).

dream_state.description: R-128-F (speculative): a separate substrate where dream-region content could play. v0.3 framing.

legacy_inherited_substrate_weight.description: R-131-F (speculative): per-substrate weight inherited from prior characters. Per X.12/X.16 legacy seeding; multi-character campaign play.

per_actor.description: R-143-P: per-actor canon credit (companion_id or player_id → credit object). Replaces v0.4 player-only.

party_member_witnesses.description: R-147-P: companion_ids that witnessed this event. Multi-witness mechanics — Bell Court testimony, Drowned Church doctrinal weighting.

agent_provenance.description: R-95-B: map of event-field-path → agent_name that produced it. Debug aid + replay determinism.

combat_state.description: R-146-P: combat state inside event. No separate combat entity in v0.5 (deferred bundle).

diegetic_elements.description: R-114-D: per-scene catalog of clickable diegetic UI elements with their state. Scoped to events because event has scene context.

public_summary_for_ticker.description: R-118-D: optional ticker-ready summary populated by Narrator. Null when event is not surfaceable.

scene_id.description: R-122-E: groups events by scene for easier filtering. Replaces implicit grouping.

faction_obligation_state_per_companion.description: R-145-P: faction-mediated terms per-companion. Keyed by companion_id.

scheduled_actions.description: R-123-E: faction plans with scheduled execution day. Per Notice Ladder Tracker timing R-79.

tracker_state.description: R-98-B: per-NPC tracker fields when operating as a Notice-Ladder tracker. Per R-82 Notice Ladder.

recruitable_via_bond.description: R-139-P: NPC can be recruited via bond-path (organic-trust-build over multiple scenes).

recruitable_via_canon_event.description: R-140-P: NPC becomes recruitable on this canon-event-kind firing. event_kind reference or null.

behavior_tree_state.description: R-108-C (deferred): behavior tree state for NPCs. Awaiting v0.5 NPC behavior tree design pass.

grudge_ledger.description: R-110-C (deferred): persistent grudges with weight + source_event_id. NPC memory beyond current_plan.

witness_history.description: R-121-E: NPC's witness history. NPC Evaluator uses this for response generation.

want_model.description: Phase 24b / Bundle A / L.I-SC-01 — NPC drive/barter/kill_for/fear_loss. REQUIRED in v0.8.

knowledge_tri_layer.description: Phase 24b / Bundle A / L.I-SC-02 — knows/says/believes. REQUIRED in v0.8.

closing_conditions.description: Phase 24b / Bundle A / L.I-SC-03 — Death's binding rule: ≥2 entries; ≥1 MUST have player_reachable=true (engine validation enforces; can't express in pure JSON Schema). REQUIRED in v0.8.

x_validation.description: Engine validator rejects NpcSchema when no closing_conditions[i].player_reachable === true.

memory_archetype.description: Phase 24b / Bundle A / L.I-SC-04 — Memory-pattern archetype. 'contradiction_bearing' documents Death's binding rule waiver (Listening Child, Butcher Who Repeats). Native Postgres ENUM. REQUIRED in v0.8.

ambition_tick.description: Phase 24b / Bundle A / L.I-SC-05 — NPC's drive-attempt cadence. REQUIRED in v0.8.

schedule_nesting.description: Phase 24b / Bundle A / L.I-SC-06 — Per-NPC schedule nested under institution. REQUIRED in v0.8.

stats.description: Phase 4a.5 / Khoja Decision #2 — ALL NPCs get 9-CoreStat Tide-Stained stats. Scenery-tier NPCs use median baseline (10 across the 6 core; 0 across authority/ruin/creation).

derived_stats.description: Phase 4a.5 / Khoja Decision #2 — ALL NPCs get 5e ability scores via deterministic translation from stats (translation rules at Session 4c).

replay_seed.description: R-92-B: RNG seed that produced this state_diff. Required for tests/replay_determinism.py.

validator_chain_pass_detailed.description: R-94-B: per-stage validator result with reason on failure. Expansion of v0.4 boolean validator_chain_pass.

dependency_event_ids.description: R-96-B: event_ids this diff depends on having committed first. Required for replay ordering.

surfacing_state.description: R-126-E: contradiction surfacing trigger. R-81 closure.

surface_after_day.description: R-126-E: day at which contradiction should surface to player. Null = never auto-surface.

faith_meter_negative_value_ui_treatment.description: R-125-E: how negative faith values render in UI. R-83 closure.

tags.description: Tooling/content tags (slice_eligible, imposed_eligible, etc.). Replaces semantic misuse of domain_aligned for tagging.

creates_canon_event_on_cast.description: Explicit flag: this spell creates a canon event when cast. Helps State Manager event-emission logic vs. inferring from cost_layer.

subschool.description: Subschool within parent school. 14 subschools used in v0.4.3 originals.

wild_twist.description: One-line distinctive mechanical twist of an original spell. Surfaced in spell-picker UI for discoverability.

effects_on_attune_structured.description: SC-16: structured replacement for effects_on_attune (string[]). Tooling-parseable. Original effects_on_attune field retained for backward compat.

effects_on_equip_structured.description: SC-16: structured replacement for effects_on_equip (string[]). Tooling-parseable. Original effects_on_equip field retained for backward compat.

effects_on_use_structured.description: SC-16: structured replacement for effects_on_use (string[]). Tooling-parseable. Original effects_on_use field retained for backward compat.

soul_kind.description: R-73: soul_kind gating — what kind of soul-substrate this item carries. Bound at craft-commit per Bundle A.

witness_payload.description: Witness-bearing payload on items. R-73 (Bundle A) + SC-07.

adaptagen_kind.description: R-103-C (deferred mad-sci): item is an adaptagen of this kind. Null for non-adaptagen items.

evolution_ledger.description: R-129-F (speculative): items that change over time without crafting. The rust pattern on a long-held weapon. World-remembers extension.

station_alternative_routes.description: R-120-E: M2 finding R-85. If primary station inaccessible, list of fallbacks with consequences.

weather_state.description: R-130-F (speculative): weather as world-state. Currently narrated, not modeled.

template_grammar_version.description: Version flag indicating creates_item_id_template fields parse against the v0.5 grammar: variables marked as ${var_name}, substitutions resolved by State Manager at canon-event.

provenance_chain.description: SC-07: ordered history of past holders/uses, for items that carry deep memory.

tier.description: Material tier; T1<=50cp, T2=51-500, T3=501-5000, T4>5000. Was previously inferred from value_cp_per_unit bands.

slice_eligible.description: Material is approved for M8 Greywake slice ship. Replaces memory_tag interim flag.

is_intermediate.description: Material is a craft-intermediate, not a primary harvestable resource. E.g., vial_of_practiced_name_water.

sourcing_geography.description: Where this material is sourced: biome / region kind / institution control. E.g., ['salt_marsh', 'coastal', 'drowned_church_grounds'].

decay_states.description: Decay rules — material crumbles or transforms outside given context. E.g., salt-rime outside region_greywake.

craft_tracks_eligible.description: Explicit list of craft tracks that may use this material.

acquisition_method.description: How this material becomes obtainable. Some (e.g., mat_listening_child_pebble) cannot be purchased.

creature_material.x_load_bearing: 19 v0.4.2 baseline records depend on this gap closing

witness_payload.description: Some creature materials carry witness (e.g., a Drowned Church saint's bone)

dc_modifier.description: DC adjustment when alternative is used (typically positive)

yield_modifier.description: Multiplier on yield when alternative used

autonomous_drivers.description: R-136-P: 8-driver layer governing autonomous behavior between scenes

witnessed_event_ids.description: R-142-P: events this companion has witnessed (for witness-bearing mechanics)

canon_progression_credit.description: R-143-P: companions accumulate their own canon-progression credit; can experience X.12-X.16 endings

stats_block.description: Full stat block; same shape as player.stats_block

rng_seed.description: Deterministic seed for this session's RNG stream

rng_stream_position.description: Number of RNG draws consumed so far

completion_offer.description: What is offered to the player at quest completion (often the companion joining)

kind_specific_fields.description: Variant payload per kind; shape determined by kind value (deferred design pass)

triggered_by.description: What state condition (e.g., faith>=5_to_unnamed, condition_id=bonded_to_marrow_saint) triggers this overlay

tags.description: Tooling/content tags (slice_eligible, imposed_eligible, etc.). Replaces semantic misuse of domain_aligned for tagging.

creates_canon_event_on_cast.description: Explicit flag: this spell creates a canon event when cast. Helps State Manager event-emission logic vs. inferring from cost_layer.

subschool.description: Subschool within parent school. 14 subschools used in v0.4.3 originals.

wild_twist.description: One-line distinctive mechanical twist of an original spell. Surfaced in spell-picker UI for discoverability.

utc_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; primary key. Lazy reset on first read of a new date.

daily_spend_usd.description: Running total spent today across all agents and models, in USD.

daily_cap_usd.description: Configured ceiling for this date. When daily_spend_usd >= daily_cap_usd, premium tier is unavailable.

session_budgets.description: Per-session token budget tracking (in-memory mirror of DB rows for fast cap checks).

agent_tiers.description: Maps agent_id to default tier under normal conditions.

fallback_chains.description: Maps tier to ordered list of model_ids. Tried in order; first success wins.

cap_buffer_pct.description: Buffer on daily cap to absorb concurrent-Lambda race condition. e.g., 0.1 = stop at 90% of cap.

institution.description: Phase 24b §4.3 / Bundle B — Institution entity. Distinct from FactionSchema: faction-level orgs may or may not be institutions (e.g. Drowned Church is both; a feud-clan is a faction but not an institution). Institutions have cadence, jurisdictional strength, internal sub-factions, and an institutional memory archetype. Source: Sec L.II.

institution_cadence.description: Bundle B / L.II-SC-01 — Institutional decision rhythm.

jurisdictional_strength.description: Bundle B / L.II-SC-03 — Jurisdictional reach 0..100. Drives engine decisions when institution jurisdictions overlap.

internal_factions.description: Bundle B / L.II-SC-04 — Sub-factions within the institution (reformists, traditionalists, etc.).

institutional_memory_archetype.description: Bundle B / L.II-SC-05 — Institution-scale memory pattern. Strict subset of NPC memory_archetype (excludes peasant/soldier/aspirant_divine/child/contradiction_bearing — those don't scale to institutional level per L.II).

parent_faction_id.description: Optional FK to FactionSchema if the institution is a sub-org of a larger faction. Null for standalone institutions.

quest.description: Phase 24b §4.5 / Bundle D — Quest entity. Quests emerge from collision_pressure crossing surfacing_threshold; harvest NPC want_models (Bundle A), institutional failures (Bundle B), and faction reach attempts (Bundle C). Bundle E clusters quests into plots. Source: Sec L.IV.

discovery_channel.description: Bundle D / L.IV-SC-02 — How the quest surfaces.

collision_pressure.description: Bundle D / L.IV-SC-03 — Optional; populated for want_collision archetype quests.

closing_state.description: Bundle D / L.IV-SC-06 — Quest-scoped closing state (parallel to NPC closing_conditions but quest-level).

subplot_graph_relation.description: Bundle D / L.IV-SC-05 — Subplot graph + parent plot ref.

primary_npc_ids.description: NPCs central to the quest. FK to npc.npc_id.

primary_faction_ids.description: Factions central to the quest. FK to faction.faction_id.

primary_region_id.description: Region the quest is rooted in. FK to region.region_id; null for cross-regional.

campaign_id.description: Phase 4a.5 — state.* ownership sweep. FK to campaign.

session_id.description: Phase 4a.5 — state.* ownership sweep. FK to session (or save_snapshot until session entity exists).

plot.description: Phase 24b §4.6 / Bundle E / L.V-SC-01 — Plot entity. Clusters constituent quests (Bundle D) around a spine_question; may anchor a pan_world_plot. Source: Sec L.V.

spine_visibility.description: Bundle E / L.V-SC-06 — Drives UI surfacing of spine_question.

closing_state.description: Bundle E / L.V-SC-03 — 9-value enum; closed_failure_state links to FS-SC-01 failure_state_branch.

subplot_admission_policy.description: Bundle E / L.V-SC-02 — Per-plot admission policy for candidate quests.

surfacing_threshold_config.description: Phase 24b §4.5 / Bundle D / L.IV-SC-04 — Engine config governing when collision_pressure crosses to emerge as a quest. Hard cap of 7 surfaced threads per region (House L.I governor; codified).

max_surfaced_per_region.description: Hard cap per House governor. v0.8 frozen.

channel_priority.description: Ordered list of channels; engine fires first eligible.

campaign_id.description: Phase 4a.5 — engine.* ownership sweep. FK to campaign (engine state may be cross-session but per-campaign).

session_id.description: Phase 4a.5 — engine.* ownership sweep. Optional FK; engine config may be cross-session.

trade_route_v08.description: Phase 24b §4.4 / Bundle C / L.III-SC-06 — Commerce route distinct from v0.7 geographic travel_route $def. Carries commodity + capacity + controlling faction + active status. Reconciled with v0.7 travel_route via engine adapter at scene-load boundary.

commodity_id.description: FK to commodity_catalog_entry.commodity_id (catalog entries live in $defs, registered at engine init).

weather_dependency.description: True if route is disrupted by seasonal weather.

capacity_per_season.description: Max commodity units transportable per season.

institution_response_queue_entry.description: Phase 24b §4.3 / Bundle B / L.II-SC-02 — Per-event entry in an institution's response queue. Lives in state.* schema (per ARD-010; mutable runtime queue). Engine writes entries when triggering events fire; resolves by NPC actions or institutional default policy.

trigger_event_id.description: FK → event that requires institutional response.

items.description: FK → npc.npc_id for member who acted.

resolution_kind.description: Null while pending; populated when window closes or member NPC acts. Null permitted via column type; enum values list excludes null since Postgres ENUMs are non-nullable as a type.

campaign_id.description: Phase 4a.5 — state.* ownership sweep. FK to campaign.

failure_state_branch.description: Phase 24b §4.7 / FS-SC-01 — Per-plot failure-state branch (lives in state.* because plot outcomes mutate per session). Holds trigger conditions, cosmological reach, winner/loser sets, and a handle window. Bound to FS-RULE-1 (≥3 day handle window) + FS-RULE-2 (readable signal via point_of_no_return_marker within 1 in-world day).

handle_window_days.description: FS-RULE-1 binding: player has ≥3 in-world days to intervene before the branch finalizes.

creature.description: Phase 24b §4.7 / BES-SC-01 — Bestiary entity (content.* namespace). Distinct from NPC (no DialogueState/Wants/Ambitions): adversarial/encountered being with combat block + provenance. Witness-payload flag marks creatures whose presence/sighting constitutes a canon-progression event.

regional_presence_id.description: FK to cross_regional_presence.primitive_id when this creature has pan-world reach.

uncertainty_resolver_id.description: FK to outcome_uncertainty_resolver.primitive_id when this creature triggers Unnamed-Touched echo.

witness_payload.description: True if sighting/encountering this creature constitutes a canon-progression event (cosmological/substrate-revealing).

combatant.description: Phase 24b §4.7 / CMB-SC-01 — Combatant entity (content.* namespace). Extends NPC via base_npc_id FK with combat-specific overlay: voice_archetype routes to Bundle F personality_fingerprint, social_attacks[] references social_attack $def. Cosmological_redirection FK for Sum-Wraith Whisperer signature mechanic.

base_npc_id.description: FK to npc.npc_id — combatant inherits stats/derived_stats/tags from base NPC.

voice_archetype.description: Phase 4.8 harmonized — shares personality_archetype enum with personality_fingerprint.archetype_id (Bundle F L.VI-SC-02).

cosmological_redirection_id.description: FK to cosmological_redirection.primitive_id when combatant has Sum-Wraith Whisperer signature.

prompt_skeleton.description: Phase 24b §4.8 / Bundle F / L.VI-SC-04 — Generation scaffold for NPC dialogue. UNIFIES Cluster A npc_prompt_skeleton per Session 3.5 overlap resolution. Two flavors: archetype-templated (default) and cluster_a_override=true (constraint-dominant per L.VI-SC-05 / fingerprint_waiver).

npc_id.description: Null = template skeleton (shared across NPCs of same archetype). Non-null = NPC-specific override.

cluster_a_override.description: True for Cluster A constraint-dominant overrides (Listening Child + Butcher per L.VI-SC-05). When true, fingerprint_waiver_id must be set and personality_fingerprint generation is bypassed.

information.description: Phase 24b §4.9 / Bundle G / L.VII-SC-01 — Bundle G core entity. Discrete unit of in-world information with provenance (source_npc / source_event), veracity classification, decay (half_life_days), and optional concealment + archetype-lock policies. Pairs with daily_news_3tier for time-banded surfacing.

info_class.description: L.VII-SC-02 RT-40 frozen 7-value classification. DO NOT extend without RT-40 revision.

source_event_id.description: FK to event.event_id when info originates from a witnessed event.

half_life_days.description: In-world days before info salience halves. 0 = perpetual (doctrine/prophecy).

items.description: FK to shaping_operator.operator_id; applied in order on transmission.
